title: Seventyseven Cord Utility Shorts
notes: Shopify. JSON-LD ships a malformed image URL (`https:files/...` — no slashes) that resolves into a non-existent path on the storefront domain. Parser must reject these schemed-but-non-authoritative URLs. The legitimate gallery (Island_Leaf shots) is in tags; the Tawny_Wood color is a separate variant whose images are also in the markup.
